open_points.subject: probe_backup_location
open_points.text: probe_backup_location: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer a ProbePassed when the probe file was created and removed, and otherwise a StartDiagnostic whose diagnostic names the backup_dir item by the name of its backup_dir parameter, which is that item's field name, as every start diagnostic names an item, and what failed, the location missing or not a directory or the file not created or not removed, never the location's path; a probe file it could not remove MUST be left where it is, for the next run's removal of temporary files.
open_points.rule: Адрес, записанный без `=` — в обратных кавычках или словами, — не разыменовывается вовсе: до модели не доходит ни значение, ни символ, и она вынуждена значение сочинить. Обе формы невалидны для значения, которое читает генерируемый код.
open_points.question: The diagnostic item name must be supplied through one of the permitted value paths—restore a canonical `= models.RuntimeSettings` schema reference that exposes the field name, or provide the item name as an imported constant—instead of deriving the emitted value from the parameter's name.
